other_conditions: Must be registered on the DBT portal.
Must be interested in planting coconut saplings.
Benefit is given to the farmer family (husband, wife, and minor child).
Selection is on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
benefits_summary: 75% subsidy on each sapling (₹63.75 off ₹85) and provision of 5 to 712 saplings per beneficiary.
